title: My Hope Since I Was Little
traveler_why: Willow is the warm one who feels Heavenly Father’s gentle love, and tonight’s psalm is an old man looking back on a lifetime of care: Willow giggles at her baby pictures, and Mom tells her Heavenly Father has loved and watched over her the whole time.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she feels Heavenly Father’s gentle, lifelong love. In Willow’s world today: Willow looked at baby pictures and giggled at how tiny she used to be. Mom said, “Heavenly Father has loved you and watched over you this whole time.” Willow’s heart felt warm and safe, knowing she was never once alone. Just like the psalm-writer trusted Heavenly Father his whole life, Willow felt His love from the very beginning until now.
